message: Following Rohin’s reported raw_child example—carrying unfinished work forward and checking what happened before claiming progress—which change, if any, makes this draft clearer when you compare the sentences themselves? Would more thought settle what physically happens in the almost-scream sentence, or would trying another version provide better evidence? What thinking or writing step do you choose to complete next? What observation in the passage would make you change that choice? What finding from the visible draft, remaining uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
